tags.feature: 🎥 If the character a player is spectating dies, the camera now switches to a living character

tags.bug: ⚠️ Sometimes items could disappear when switching them in passages and crawl spaces
🎮 Playing as Granny with a gamepad, it was impossible to attack with the bat
🛏 The camera wouldn’t rotate under the bed when controlled with a gamepad
🔨 If Granny killed a character under the bed, the item could fall beneath it and become unreachable
🌐 If a player’s game crashed in the lobby, they would still remain visible in the lobby list for others

notes.title: Version 1.1 Final Cutscenes!
notes.content:
I am delighted to announce the release of version 1.1 of Granny: Escape Together. This update introduces final cutscenes!

A number of improvements and bug fixes have also been implemented to ensure a smoother gameplay experience. You can see the full list of changes below.

[b]Major Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 4 final cutscenes
[/list]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Introduced a new loot spawn preset
[*] Added volume control for jump scares
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] After Grandpa's attack, 2 days were skipped
[*] Field of View (FOV) was reset after a jump scare
[*] Grandpa got stuck near one of the shelters in the maze
[*] Granny couldn't open doors in the room with hooks
[*] Issue when moving the character with a wheel
[*] Installed well handle wasn't visible to the other player
[*] It was possible to lock Granny in the attic and freely explore the house
[*] Could escape through the door without cutting the wire in the electrical box
[*] Loot items were not picked up in places where floors creaked
[*] Charged weapon was unloaded at the start of the day
[*] In multiplayer, if a loaded shotgun was dropped, the other player picking it up couldn't see it was loaded
[*] Granny got stuck in a wooden box where the player was hiding
[*] At the start of a new day, the car trunk closed, and a player who hadn't unlocked it couldn't open it
[*] "Bear Trap" text didn't disappear after escaping from the trap
[/list]

[h3]Thanks everyone for your support![/h3]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Changelog
notes.content:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Items thrown into the well now respawn in the yard.
[*] Added FOV adjustment setting.
[*] Added option to disable jiggle physics.
[*] Adjusted the positioning of the text chat.
[*] Optimized performance of the TV effect.
[*] Improved item spawn locations.
[*] Added support for 3440x1440 resolution.

[/list]
[b]Bugs Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where items disappeared in underground tunnels.
[*] Menu settings sometimes did not save correctly.
[*] The screen occasionally turned dark at the start of the game.
[*] Fixed a bug in the settings menu where changes were not applied on the first attempt.
[*] Adjusted terrain collider.
[*] After being attacked by Grandpa, if the player became a spectator, the chase music would not stop.
[*] Granny could be shot during a jumpscare with the shotgun.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Testing Begins on November 8!
notes.content:
[h3]The first stage of beta testing kicks off on November 8. 

This stage will include a 2 vs AI mode, where you can try out the mechanics and share your feedback — it will really help me improve the game further.

Currently, the beta version is only available in English, but I plan to add support for other languages in the full version.

Join the beta test and help make the game even better! I’d also be happy to see you on my [url=https://discord.com/invite/aS54dtr7Xt]Discord server[/url], where you can discuss the game, share your impressions, and provide suggestions.[/h3]
